article.headline: Sorber scores 22 as Georgetown beats Coppin State 83-53
article.description: — Thomas Sorber's 22 points helped Georgetown defeat Coppin State 83-53 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Sorber scores 22 as Georgetown beats Coppin State 83-53
article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Thomas Sorber's 22 points helped Georgetown defeat Coppin State 83-53 on Saturday. Sorber also had 12 rebounds and four blocks for the Hoyas (11-2). Drew Fielder scored 20 points while shooting 6 of 7 from the field and 8 for 8 from the line and added 13 rebounds. Malik Mack finished with 15 points. The Eagles (1-13) were led in scoring by Toby Nnadozie, who finished with 22 points. Julius Ellerbe added 12 points and six steals for Coppin State. Zahree Harrison finished with nine points and four steals. Georgetown took the lead with 19:44 left in the first half and did not give it up. The score was 37-30 at halftime, with Sorber racking up 13 points. Georgetown pulled away with a 21-2 run in the second half to extend a seven-point lead to 26 points. They outscored Coppin State by 23 points in the final half, as Mack led the way with a team-high nine second-half points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
